strategic_recommendations: Film the hook within the first 2 seconds – place the paradox or visual surprise immediately, then cut to the explanation.
Upgrade thumbnails: use high‑contrast colors, large emoji, and a single bold question word (e.g., "WHY?", "HOW?", "WHAT?"), testing A/B with YouTube’s thumbnail picker.
Add on‑screen keyword tags (3‑5 words) synced with the spoken hook to reinforce algorithmic relevance and improve discoverability.
